members.title: Filter MCPServer capabilities by registered primitives
members.author: MukundaKatta
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2499: Both PRs add an identical `capability_filter` parameter to `MCPServer.__init__` and store it as `self._capability_filter`, solving the same issue of the server advertising capabilities without registered handlers. The only structural difference is parameter placement: #2477 inserts it before `on_ping`, while #2499 inserts it after `on_ping` and before the notification-handlers block.
